notes.title: English Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are delighted that some English-speaking players have recently shown interest in Card Cultivation. We have added an English option to introduce more players from different language backgrounds to enjoy the game. You can switch to English in the [b]Language[/b] settings to experience the game.

[h3]Please note that the current English version is a preliminary translation, and the text may not yet be fully adapted to the game content. This could result in a less smooth gameplay experience.[/h3]

We plan to optimize the translation after the Spring Festival to provide a more seamless and high-quality multilingual experience. Thank you for your understanding and support!

Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/WKMUYm8q9X]Discord channel[/url] if you have feedback about the game. If you enjoy Card Cultivation, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Card Cultivation to Participate in the 2025 Steam Chinese New Year Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Friends,[/b]

We are excited to announce that [i]Card Cultivation[/i] will participate in the 2025 Steam Chinese New Year Sale from January 27th to February 10th. During this period, we will continue to offer Playtest access.

We plan to close the Playtest on February 11th, after which we will focus on developing more content for [i]Card Cultivation[/i]. We aim to release a Steam Demo within the first quarter and welcome you to try it out when it's available.

We also encourage you to provide feedback and suggestions during the testing phase to help us improve the game together.

[h3]For more information about the game, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/WKMUYm8q9X]Discord Channel.[/url] If you enjoy Card Cultivation, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist![/h3]

notes.title: 《卡牌修仙传》开启首轮玩家测试招募！
notes.content:
朋友们你们好！我们在今日发布了《卡牌修仙传》的商店页面，很高兴能向你们介绍这款游戏的精彩信息：

我们计划招募一批内测玩家，在10月9日开启首轮内部Alpha玩法测试，测试期间玩家可以提前游玩到未公开的游戏内容，并通过问卷反馈问题和建议，我们将在所有参与测试并填写反馈问卷的玩家中送出30张30人民币充值卡！

如果您想参与这次测试，请填写这份招募问卷：[url=https://wj.qq.com/s2/15365940/buz9/]https://wj.qq.com/s2/15365940/buz9/[/url]

我们将以招募问卷的填写结果作为筛选标准，请各位认真作答，期待你们能成为首次测试的玩家并提出宝贵的意见！！



《卡牌修仙传》是由我们开发的以卡牌为主要形式的修仙题材模拟器游戏，玩法灵感来源于《堆叠大陆》与《密教模拟器》，为您带来水墨风格的全新“修仙”体验。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221155/c6bc75e173cbb91d3d5596c0da90cbdb379046a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221155/65676175736fe408fcca3429c1f402589e8e6746.png[/img]
《卡牌修仙传》的故事从一位失忆的侠士在风水宝地醒来开始，一边修炼飞升一边寻找自己身世的秘密。
在这个以《山海经》为底蕴设计的世界里，修炼心法、炼制丹药、收集法宝、拜入宗门、探索妖穴等，你都能以卡牌的形式体验到。超一千张卡牌、五十多个秘境，带你体验这个独特的修仙世界。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221155/810a2cd6fff897b9ed0e1db2778976d00f2706c3.gif[/img]

点击链接查看我们最新发布的游戏玩法视频：[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HHxKeVEF4/]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HHxKeVEF4/[/url]

游戏特点：

[list]
[*] 有趣的卡牌化修仙玩法：游戏中的所有内容均以卡牌方式展示，通过卡牌和卡牌、卡牌与工作台之间的交互型衍生出多样的交互结果。

[*] 自由的桌上大世界：以山海经为底蕴设计的架空修仙世界，自由御剑飞行，遭遇各种随机事件，打造绝世武器培养灵宠炼制丹药。

[*] 丰富的卡牌内容：超过1000+张卡牌，20+工作台，50+秘境。包含人物，法宝，心法，材料，草药，妖兽，宗门等诸多修仙世界的内容。
[/list]

如果您对《卡牌修仙传》感兴趣，请将它加入您的愿望单，这对我们是莫大的支持与鼓励！
